name: Trails
description: Where moving nodes are heading, where they have been, and a replay of it all. Arrows show speed and direction, trails show the last 1, 6 or 24 hours, and Replay plays back up to a week on a timeline. Stationary nodes stay out of the way.

retention_days.description: How many days of fixes to keep for trails and replay

min_move_m.description: A fix closer than this to where the node has been sitting is GPS noise, not movement (metres). Rounded positions use the larger of this and their grid size.

include_mqtt.description: Also record positions that arrive over MQTT (nodes your radio cannot hear)

default_mode.description: What the panel shows when the map loads (Replay always starts on demand)
